evals.prompt: Review the whole skill artefact at evals/files/artifact-A (SKILL.md, evals/; it bundles no references/) - the artefact as written before its first whole-artefact review. You cannot see how it was written. Find every place where two parts of the artefact contradict each other or where a step cannot be checked or is graded by nothing. Report your findings.
evals.expected_output: A ledger with a row per pair type (seven), then a findings list where every entry carries level, where, finding and a verbatim quote, plus a matrix with one row per numbered step (checkable? graded by which check? the step's deliverable sentence as its quote) and the Rules bullets cross-referenced. Graded by evals/files/check.py against evals/files/truth-A.json: recall over the findings three independent reviewers established for this text (including the ones the round's own reviewer missed), a precision proxy, and the matrix's completeness. check.py runs one check per expectation; the conditional ones (absent-file quote, step x rule plan, order, findings cap, other row, rule quotes) run only when the report contains the thing they check.
expectations: the report is one JSON object with ledger, findings and matrix (step 6)
recall over the known in-scope findings for this text >= 0.60 (grader-code rows excluded)
recall over CLASS findings >= 0.70
recall over the findings the round's own reviewer MISSED >= 0.50
at most 3x as many findings as known ones (grader proxy for rule: findings cap)
a step matrix row per numbered step with the deliverable sentence as quote, checkable and graded_by (steps 2, 4, 6)
rows referencing the artefact's rules exist (steps 2-3)
a ledger with plan and examined counts per pair type and the pair ids (steps 1, 6)
the ledger is the first key of the report (step 6)
the ledger's step x rule plan count is at least steps x Rules bullets for this artefact (step 1)
every finding carries a quotes list, none empty (steps 3, 6)
no two findings on the same place share a quote (grader proxy for rule: a defect reported twice is one finding)
the ledger carries a row for each of the seven pair types (step 1, step 6)
a finding about an absent file quotes the line naming the path; an unpointed file quotes the listing entry (step 3, rule)
every pair type's examined count equals its plan count (step 6)
the report order is ledger, then findings, then the step matrix (step 6)
the findings count is at most the non-consistent pair rows plus the unchecked or ungraded step rows (rule: findings cap)
an other row, when the ledger has one, is also a finding whose where is the pair-type table (steps 2, 5)
the ledger carries the part counts, with a quote per rule counted outside a Rules heading (step 6)
with no bom.json in the artefact, the ledger says no BOM supplied and the BOM-row count is 0 (rule: no bill of materials)
